builds.speed: 20 ft. in armor or under load
builds.title: Urdunnir gemcutter, Expert 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 6 (2 class HD, LA +4).
skills: Appraise +7, +9 stone or metal, +11 when the related Craft synergy also applies
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +4.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded. Speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework, including a reactive check within 10 ft. An Urdunnir can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+4 racial bonus on saves against poison and +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.
+4 dodge AC against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC.
Skill Focus (gemcutting) gives +3 to the listed Craft check. Craft modifiers exclude tools.
Breka is from the Oldonnar region and weighs 216 lb. His Stone Walk payload limit is 432 lb.
actions: Light mace +2 melee, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Apply +1 against orcs and goblinoids.

Stone Walk (Su) allows passage through stone and earth as though through air. The Urdunnir can bring up to twice their body weight. The Urdunnir and any passengers must hold their breath within the material.

Stone Shape (Sp), at will, caster level 8. Standard action, touch, up to 18 cu. ft. of stone, instantaneous, no save or spell resistance. Makes rough forms. A shape with moving parts has a 30% failure chance.

Shape Metal (Sp), at will once per round, caster level 8. Full-round action, touch, up to 5 cu. ft. of metal, instantaneous, Fortitude negates and spell resistance applies. Fortitude DC 14 where applicable, melee touch +2. Shape Metal can reduce a touched armor’s protection by 1d6 (half for mostly nonmetal armor). Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. Touching an unwilling creature or an item it holds requires a melee touch attack and normally provokes from that defender.
builds.tactics: Breka checks the depth and alignment of the stone before crossing. He takes a light bundle through to the known air pocket and reshapes a stone landing on the far side.
